stock.description: Established in 2000 and headquartered in Tsim Sha Tsui East, Hong Kong, Medialink Group Limited operates as a global media enterprise primarily engaged in the distribution of third-party owned content. It serves a broad international market, encompassing regions like Mainland China, Hong Kong, the United States, Japan, Singapore, Italy, Taiwan, the United Kingdom, Thailand, France, Indonesia, and the Philippines. The company's structure comprises two main business segments: Media Content Distribution and Brand Licensing. The Media Content Distribution segment focuses on acquiring and disseminating diverse media properties, including animated series, factual entertainment, dramatic productions, and full-length feature films (both animated and live-action), all procured from third-party content creators. Meanwhile, the Brand Licensing division specializes in managing and brokering intellectual property rights for various brands. These rights encompass merchandising for products ranging from toys and apparel to health/beauty goods and food/beverages; location-based entertainment for experiential venues like events, theme parks, and dining establishments; and general promotional use. Additionally, Medialink Group Limited actively invests in new media content production.
